Hi,

if you tried to update to aroma.affymetrix v1.8.0 but you're still
stuck with v1.7.0, then it was due to a server mistake. It should
work now:

source("http://aroma-project.org/hbLite.R");
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix");

Sorry about that!
